A_target.statement:
Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a [[Definition:Probability Space|probability space]].
Let $A_1, \ldots, A_n \in \Sigma$ with $\map \Pr {A_i} = 0$ for all $i$.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \map \Pr {\bigcup_{i \mathop = 1}^n A_i} = 0$

B_source.statement:
Let $\struct {\Omega, \Sigma, \Pr}$ be a [[Definition:Probability Space|probability space]] and $A_1, \ldots, A_n \in \Sigma$.
Then:
:$\displaystyle \map \Pr {\bigcup_{i \mathop = 1}^n A_i} \le \sum_{i \mathop = 1}^n \map \Pr {A_i}$

validity_conditions: Substituting P(A_i) = 0 makes the right-hand side sum equal 0.
The union bound gives P(union A_i) <= 0.
proof_plan:
By [[Definition:Probability Measure|definition]], $\Pr$ is non-negative.
Hence:
:$\displaystyle \map \Pr {\bigcup_{i \mathop = 1}^n A_i} = 0$
{{qed}}
